notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You control seven or more lands with different names.
easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.name: Thornbite Staff
uses.cardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary
